newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends mixed, off 18-wk high versus mark.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends mixed, off 18-wk high versus mark.

text.p: 1500 GMT - The Swiss franc hit its highest level against the mark in 18 weeks on Wednesday but closed lower versus the German currency in Europe.

The Swiss franc got as high as 84.69 centimes versus the mark in overnight trade, its highest level against the German currency since 84.34 on December 6. Aurel David, technical currency analyst at Bank Julius Baer, said that for the next couple of days he saw a chance for mark/Swiss to move higher against the mark, with 84.50 centimes as an interim target.
Beyond that, the mark may be poised for a further move to 85.70 francs and beyond, he said.
The dollar also appeared to be technically ready to gain after it ended lower against the Swiss franc on Wednesday, he said, citing the next key level as 1.47 to the upside.
Analysts at CSFB, however, said they still had a short-term technical target for 84.15/05 on mark/Swiss.
The short-term target refers to roughly one week. The analysts also said however that the pace of the mark/Swiss decline had slowed, reflecting an oversold condition.
*Dollar closes lower at 1.4685/4690 Swiss francs versus 1.4715/4725 francs at Tuesday's close. *Mark ends at 85.02/05 Swiss centimes versus 84.84/86 centimes at the Tuesday close.
